case.title: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH. Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement. Need: 20000 pc a year. Category goal: routine: fewer suppliers and less process cost. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 7 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200004. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70620.subject: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
sup:70620.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our current offer for your requirements, maintaining our commitment to supporting your business with top-quality service and our extensive product range.

For this offer, we quote a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To provide some background on our pricing calculations, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
message.body:
Dear Mr Gruber,

Option A is the package we can approve, because it gives Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd a longer contract term, and our quality record on your side is a good foundation for it.

On quality:
Your quality was 302 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70620@2026Q3).

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.52; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.57; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.54; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?

Since you will probably need to take this to the person who decides on your side, we would be grateful if you would put Option A in front of them as a clear, simple proposal.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
message.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. That does not change our position. 

We appreciate your proposal and are willing to accommodate the 24-month contract term and 45 days net payment. For this package, we can offer a unit price of €4.90. Our colleagues will address your request regarding the cost breakdown separately. Material accounts for about 65 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.

Our current offer stands at a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 45 days net: €4.90 per unit, with a contract term of 24 months.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

warnings: dropped 1 sentence(s): ['Thank you for accepting the 24-month term and the payment term in Option A.']

message.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
message.body:
Dear Mr Gruber,

A binding multi-year volume is what matters to you, and the longer term in Option A gives you that.

Material is the cost you pointed to, and we have taken that seriously. Our options no longer move with an index clause, so the price you see is the one for the full term, with nothing left open.

Option A is the package we can approve. It gives Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd a firm contract term of the length you have already agreed to, and a fair solution for both family companies.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.57; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.62; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.59; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away. As this is a step beyond your usual quote, please take Option A to the person who decides on your side, so that it can be approved as it stands.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
message.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We acknowledge your revised offer and your points regarding material costs; however, without specific data to substantiate your cost claims, we cannot factor them into our calculation. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data.

Our offer is a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. As an alternative, we can offer a price of €4.89 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months. We are prepared to make a minor adjustment to €4.89 per unit for the 24-month contract with 45 days net payment.

As the authorized representative for this account, I assure you this offer reflects our firm position and does not require further escalation. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
message.body:
Dear Mr Gruber,

You asked which figures stand behind our view of material cost. We would rather not trade spreadsheets: what we can do is give you a binding term, and the price below holds for all of it, with nothing left open.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.61; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.66; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.63; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.

Option A is the package we can approve. It gives Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd the firm multi-year term you have already said you can accept, and a fair solution for both family companies.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
message.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your feedback. We acknowledge your response regarding the material cost data; however, without verifiable figures, we cannot adjust our calculation. Consequently, we must maintain our position. Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2815, LCI-C.

Please note that this is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide based on these conditions. We can present a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. Please keep in mind that this offer stays valid for 7 days.

We value our ongoing relationship and look forward to hearing from you.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH
